[2] Vlad scales up to become a monster but on your chapter spike you should be able to shove in and have a lot of impact on the map.
[2] We need deny as much as possible from him early and bolster team lead. Also tricky champ late.

[3] She cant really do that much if you dodge her abilities, just force her into her tower and hold your W for possible ganks.
[3] It's not that hard, you have to care for her combo and farm until 5-6.
